bio: I'm a Computer Science undergraduate with hands-on experience in data analytics, research, and data-driven product development. I specialize in transforming raw data into actionable insights that support decision-making and real-world impact.

Currently targeting roles as a Data Analyst, with a strong interest in Data Science and Data Engineering, and a long-term vision of building scalable, AI-powered solutions and impactful tech products.

status.targets: Data Analyst · Data Scientist · Data Engineer

experience.description: Analyzed 30+ research papers to identify limitations in existing steganographic models. Architected and developed a CNN-based encoder–decoder and detector for satellite image steganography, achieving 99.99% training accuracy and 95.60% cross-domain accuracy. Enabled 256-bit payload embedding with controlled distortion (PSNR up to 147.16 dB; MSE ≤ 0.041) and validated stealth robustness through domain-generalized detectability benchmarking.
Analyzed large-scale energy consumption data using AI tools to derive actionable insights. Developed interactive dashboards to visualize trends and support sustainability-focused initiatives.

projects.title: Anomate Stream – Anomaly Detection System
projects.description: Built an end-to-end anomaly detection system to identify unusual patterns in system-level data, supporting security and performance monitoring. Applied machine learning techniques to analyze CPU, memory, and system call data, achieving high detection accuracy. Developed an interactive dashboard for visualizing anomalies, enabling data upload, labeling, and exportable insights for decision-making.
